mapper.select: SELECT terms_id, terms_name, content, terms_code, terms_version, required_yn, is_active FROM terms WHERE is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY required_yn DESC, terms_id ASC
SELECT terms_id, terms_name, content, terms_code, terms_version, required_yn, is_active FROM terms WHERE terms_id = #{termsId} AND is_active = 'Y'
SELECT terms_id, terms_name, content, terms_code, terms_version, required_yn, is_active FROM terms WHERE terms_id = #{termsId}
SELECT terms_id, terms_name, content, terms_code, terms_version, required_yn, is_active FROM terms ORDER BY terms_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO terms( terms_name, terms_code, terms_version, content, required_yn, is_active ) VALUES( #{termsName}, #{termsCode}, #{termsVersion}, #{content}, #{requiredYn}, 'Y' )
mapper.update: UPDATE terms SET is_active = 'N' WHERE terms_id = #{termsId} AND is_active = 'Y'
